otherSources.name: Vía Navegable Troncal · BellaVista
otherSources.reason: The server omits its Sectigo intermediate certificate; normal Firefox and system TLS clients reject the chain. With that intermediate independently verified against system roots, the public page returned HTTP 200 without authentication and exposed LL-HLS/fMP4 manifests. This format is also outside the current MPEG-TS relay contract. Retained as technically blocked, not presumed offline or permission-restricted; no insecure TLS bypass was used.

verification.method: Certificate-chain diagnosis and public page/manifest HTTP checks; no camera playback claim

discovery.method: Directory links were leads; runtime URLs were checked on public operator pages or public YouTube players. Broad regional/province searches complemented these leads. Directory camera totals are not counts of distinct active reusable feeds.
limits: ArgosAtlas public pages supplied leads only; no subscription-only catalogue or media was accessed.
Estado del Mar guest/player tokens were not persisted or reused; its 52 source pages may overlap other operators.
No CCTV IP scanning, login-gated sources, signed URL extraction or access-control bypass.
Source-only entries are findings, not additional verified active cameras. A provider may appear more than once for distinct named views.
Codelis/Clima24.7 no longer presented a suitable public webcam catalogue at the checked address.
No verified operator feed was found for Formosa, Jujuy, La Pampa, La Rioja or Santiago del Estero in this survey; this does not establish absence.
